name: product-manager
description: Connect product discovery, business logic, traceable requirements, roadmaps, delivery coverage, and outcome feedback without taking over architecture.

interface.shortDescription: Connect discovery, business logic, roadmaps, and product feedback.
interface.longDescription: Shape customer and business outcomes, approve one lightweight requirement baseline, trace delivery automatically, and escalate only material product decisions while leaving technical architecture to its owning role.
defaultPrompt: Use $product-manager to connect this customer problem to a business outcome and product decision.
Use $product-roadmap to create an evidence-based Now/Next/Later roadmap.
Use $product-requirements to approve one requirement baseline, trace delivery automatically, and escalate only material exceptions.
